Dueling-context PCA viewer

Per-node mean residuals → top-3 PCs. Drag the plot to orbit the 3D space; drag context length to move through the prefix→joint timeline (frames Procrustes-aligned in 3D; fractional positions interpolate). Scroll to zoom.

Hue = node index (0–15). Edges are drawn from the true graphs, so a geometry is “recovered” when its edges look short & planar. Fresh = blank context fed only the jointly-generated stream.
